import ctypes
import os


def compute_bessel_asymp_thetanu_corr(nu, x):
    # Load the required libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the function prototype
    gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_asymp_thetanu_corr_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
    gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_asymp_thetanu_corr_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

    # Prepare the result variable
    result = ctypes.c_double()

    # Call the function
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_asymp_thetanu_corr_e(ctypes.c_double(nu), ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))

    # Check for success
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("GSL function call failed with status code: {}".format(status))

    return result.value
